codes.name: BRML_ABSORBER_ENGAGED
codes.condition: A Bruker .brml used an automatic absorber over some points; the stored intensities already include the correction, and this records it.

codes.name: CHILD_GROUP_UNNAMED
codes.condition: magnetic_supercell() found a child group with no tabulated name. States a fact about the result; the group is still carried as operators.
codes.note: unclear: an observation about a derived group, not a repair of a file

codes.name: CIF_CELL_ANGLE_CORRECTED
codes.condition: A cell angle stored within CIF_ANGLE_CORRECT_MAX_DEG of the value its space group fixes is read as that value. A larger disagreement is not this code: it is refused (ValueError), a judgement under the act.
codes.note: gated by CIF_ANGLE_CORRECT_MAX_DEG (the WP's named tier-3 threshold)

codes.name: CIF_MAGNETIC_CENTERING_ASSUMED
codes.condition: A magCIF with no centring loop is read with the trivial centring x,y,z,+1 alone.

codes.name: CIF_MAGNETIC_ION_UNCHARGED
codes.condition: A magnetic site states no oxidation state and its label is a bare element: the neutral-atom form factor is used.

codes.name: CIF_MAGNETIC_MAGNITUDE_ESD_NOT_STORED
codes.condition: A site states moment.magnitude_su; Structure has no field for it, so it is dropped.

codes.name: CIF_MAGNETIC_MOMENT_ON_ALLOWED
codes.condition: A site moment off the subspace its site symmetry allows, by less than the file's printed precision, is moved onto it.
codes.note: gated by magcif.moment_within_print (half a unit in the last printed place, computed per row, no module constant)

codes.name: CIF_MAGNETIC_NUCLEAR_GROUP
codes.condition: Positions are refined under the nuclear group the file's operators contain, and moments under the magnetic one; recorded which relation held.
site_guards: contained and mismatch is None and (nuclear_group != 'file' or derived == parent_keys)

codes.name: CIF_MAGNETIC_NUCLEAR_SETTING
codes.condition: Positions are refined under the file's own group (or its operator list) instead of the parent it names, because the parent's setting does not contain the operators.

codes.name: CIF_MAGNETIC_NUMBER_MISMATCH
codes.condition: The BNS/UNI numbers a file states disagree with those of its own operators; the operators' numbers are stored and the stated ones dropped. The disagreement is also an assertion that the file is wrong.
codes.note: act with a judgement inside: which of two statements is right is decided for the operators

codes.name: CIF_MAGNETIC_SPHERICAL_ESD_NOT_STORED
codes.condition: A moment stated in spherical form carries su values; they are not propagated to the crystal-axis components.

codes.name: CIF_MAGNETIC_SYMMFORM
codes.condition: A site states symmform; its free-parameter count is compared with the subspace the file's operators give. Level is info when they agree (or the string is unreadable), warning when they differ. No value is changed: the derived subspace is used either way.
codes.note: level depends on a comparison the reader makes

codes.name: CIF_MAGNETIC_UNIDENTIFIED
codes.condition: The operator list does not match one of the 1651 magnetic space groups in spglib's database, so no UNI number is recorded. Reports that a lookup found nothing; no value was changed or chosen.
codes.note: unclear: an absence, neither an act nor an assertion about the file

codes.name: CIF_SITE_LISTED_TWICE
codes.condition: A site whose orbit another listed site repeats, with the same occupancy (and moment) to OCCUPANCY_TOLERANCE and DUPLICATE_U_TOLERANCE, is dropped.
codes.note: gated by OCCUPANCY_TOLERANCE, DUPLICATE_U_TOLERANCE, TWIN_DISTANCE

codes.name: CIF_SITE_MULTIPLICITY_DISAGREES
codes.condition: A stated site multiplicity differs from the one the coordinates give, and no move within CIF_STATED_MULTIPLICITY_SNAP_TOL reconciles them. Nothing is moved; the record says the file disagrees with itself.
codes.note: threshold CIF_STATED_MULTIPLICITY_SNAP_TOL decides snapped (act) versus this

codes.name: CIF_SITE_TWINS_MERGED
codes.condition: Two atoms of one site closer than TWIN_DISTANCE are read as one, on the special position.
codes.note: gated by TWIN_DISTANCE

codes.name: CIF_SPECIES_NORMALISED
codes.condition: An atom-type symbol is respelled to the canonical species (case, charge placement, isotope spelling).

codes.name: FULLPROF_MAGNETIC_PHASE_OMITTED
codes.condition: A magnetic phase of a .pcr is not built (not read as moments).

codes.name: FULLPROF_MAGNETIC_PHASE_READ
codes.condition: A magnetic phase of a .pcr is read as the moments of its nuclear phase, its SYMM/MSYM pairs becoming a magnetic group.

codes.name: FULLPROF_OCCUPANCY_UNCHECKED
codes.condition: The occupancy-ratio check compared a single site with itself, so it passed for a setting without testing it. States that a check that would have decided did not test.
codes.note: asserts that a gate was vacuous

codes.name: FULLPROF_ORIGIN_CHOICE
codes.condition: A space-group symbol with an origin choice is resolved to one; the occupancy-ratio check (_OCCUPANCY_RTOL) accepted it.
codes.note: gated by _OCCUPANCY_RTOL; the setting choice is the judgement under the act

codes.name: FULLPROF_RHOMBOHEDRAL_RESTATED
codes.condition: On writing, a rhombohedral-axes phase is written in hexagonal axes with the scale divided by 9. Raised by crystallography/symmetry.py:rhombohedral_restated_diagnostic.
site_guards: diagnostics is not None and rhombohedral
codes.note: gated by symmetry.restate_in_hexagonal_axes' own test

codes.name: FULLPROF_SPECIES_NORMALISED
codes.condition: A FullProf species is respelled to the canonical species.

codes.name: FULLPROF_SPECIES_WRITTEN_NEUTRAL
codes.condition: On writing X-ray, an ion the X-ray table lacks is written as its neutral atom. Raised by crystallography/scattering.py:written_neutral_diagnostics.
site_guards: diagnostics is not None and (not neutron)

codes.name: FULLPROF_TIE_DROPPED
codes.condition: A codeword tie in a .pcr is not carried onto the Structure (three sites: the caller asked drop_parameter_ties, a general tie, a cell tie the space group does not make).

codes.name: GSAS2_CIF_DEUTERIUM_AS_D
codes.condition: Deuterium sites are written as D; GSAS-II scatters D at 6.681 fm and rietx at 6.671 fm.
codes.note: records a disagreement between two programs' constants

codes.name: GSAS2_CIF_FIELD_NOT_WRITTEN
codes.condition: The phase CIF does not state some fields.

codes.name: GSAS2_CIF_RHOMBOHEDRAL_RESTATED
codes.condition: On writing a GSAS-II CIF, a rhombohedral-axes phase is restated in hexagonal axes (helper in symmetry.py).

codes.name: GSAS2_CIF_SETTING_IN_OPERATORS
codes.condition: The setting is stated in the operators and not in the bare symbol, for an ambiguous group.

codes.name: GSAS2_CIF_SPECIES_WRITTEN_NEUTRAL
codes.condition: On writing a GSAS-II CIF, an ion the X-ray table lacks is written neutral (helper in scattering.py).

codes.name: GSAS2_GPX_BACKGROUND_NOT_CARRIED
codes.condition: A fitted GSAS-II background's coefficients are on the model, not carried.

codes.name: GSAS2_GPX_CONSTRAINT_NOT_CARRIED
codes.condition: A .gpx's constraints are none applied; they are on model.constraints.

codes.name: GSAS2_GPX_COORDINATES_SYMMETRY_FIXED
codes.condition: As GSAS_EXP_COORDINATES_SYMMETRY_FIXED, for a .gpx.

codes.name: GSAS2_GPX_ITEM_NOT_READ
codes.condition: A .gpx item is not read; the text names it.

codes.name: GSAS2_GPX_PHASE_MAGNETIC
codes.condition: A magnetic phase of a .gpx is not built, or a nuclear phase carries a magPhases partner; level is warning when magnetic phases exist, info otherwise. Two sites.
codes.note: level depends on whether magnetic phases exist

codes.name: GSAS2_GPX_SCALE_NOT_COMPARABLE
codes.condition: As GSAS_EXP_SCALE_NOT_COMPARABLE, for a .gpx.

codes.name: GSAS2_GPX_SETTING_FROM_OPERATORS
codes.condition: A .gpx names a space group whose setting the project's operators settle differently: the operators' setting is used.

codes.name: GSAS2_GPX_SPECIES_NORMALISED
codes.condition: A GSAS-II species is respelled to the canonical species.

codes.name: GSAS2_GPX_TEXTURE_CONVERTED
codes.condition: A spherical-harmonics texture is carried with each coefficient multiplied by P_l(0) (and by √2 on n≠0 terms).
codes.note: a convention conversion under the act

codes.name: GSAS2_GPX_TEXTURE_NOT_CARRIED
codes.condition: A spherical-harmonics texture is not carried, for the reason named; level is a parameter of the helper.

codes.name: GSAS2_INSTPRM_CONVENTION_ASSUMED
codes.condition: SH/L (GSAS-II's combined (S+H)/L) is split evenly into axial_sl and axial_hl.
codes.note: an assumption (the even split) under the act

codes.name: GSAS2_INSTPRM_FIELD_DROPPED
codes.condition: TOF .instprm items were read and not carried.

codes.name: GSAS2_INSTPRM_FIELD_NOT_READ
codes.condition: An .instprm states items the Instrument has no place for; they are not read.

codes.name: GSAS2_INSTPRM_FIELD_NOT_WRITTEN
codes.condition: On writing, parts of the instrument the .instprm cannot state are omitted.

codes.name: GSAS2_INSTPRM_GEOMETRY_ASSUMED
codes.condition: An .instprm states no Diff-type: the geometry is GSAS-II's own fallback.

codes.name: GSAS2_INSTPRM_VALUE_DEFAULTED
codes.condition: An .instprm states no value for some fields: they come back at this package's default.

codes.name: GSAS2_INSTPRM_VALUE_FLOORED
codes.condition: On writing, SH/L is below INSTPRM_SHL_FLOOR: it is written as it stands, and GSAS-II floors it when it evaluates.
codes.note: notes the floor INSTPRM_SHL_FLOOR a target program applies

codes.name: GSAS2_INSTPRM_VALUE_MERGED
codes.condition: On writing, axial_sl and axial_hl differ and are written as one SH/L.

codes.name: GSAS_BANK_COMMENTED
codes.condition: A GSAS file has no live BANK record but a commented one: that one is read.
site_guards: commented and diagnostics is not None

codes.name: GSAS_EXP_BACKGROUND_NOT_CARRIED
codes.condition: A fitted GSAS background function's coefficients are on the model, not carried into a Background.

codes.name: GSAS_EXP_COORDINATES_SYMMETRY_FIXED
codes.condition: Sites carry GSAS's X refine flag but sit on fully fixed special positions: the flag is not honoured.

codes.name: GSAS_EXP_HISTOGRAM_NOT_READ
codes.condition: A histogram of a GSAS .EXP is not read; the text names why.

codes.name: GSAS_EXP_PHASE_MAGNETIC
codes.condition: A magnetic phase of a .EXP: its cell and sites are on the model, no magnetism is built.

codes.name: GSAS_EXP_REFINE_FLAG_MERGED
codes.condition: On writing, a group with some members held and some free is written free.

codes.name: GSAS_EXP_SCALE_NOT_COMPARABLE
codes.condition: The phase scale is seeded at 1e-3, not the file's histogram scale.
codes.note: a convention (the seed) under the act

codes.name: GSAS_EXP_SPECIES_NORMALISED
codes.condition: A GSAS species is respelled to the canonical species.

codes.name: GSAS_EXP_SPECIES_WRITTEN_NEUTRAL
codes.condition: On writing, an ion the X-ray table lacks is written as its neutral atom (helper in scattering.py).

codes.name: GSAS_EXP_VALUE_NARROWED
codes.condition: On writing, values needing more than the fixed columns are narrowed.

codes.name: GSAS_FIELD_OVERFLOW
codes.condition: A GSAS record field holds only asterisks (a Fortran overflow): the field is read as absent.

codes.name: GSAS_IPARM_FIELD_DROPPED
codes.condition: Records and fields with no slot in the schema are not carried.

codes.name: GSAS_IPARM_LEGACY_LAYOUT
codes.condition: A LANSCE legacy .iparm: a value running across a BNKPAR boundary is re-read by whitespace tokens (GSAS-II reads it the same way); PRCF set 1 of legacy banks is read as slots 1-8; a non-zero fifth ICOFF pair is carried as written. Three sites.

codes.name: GSAS_IPARM_PROFILE_DECLINED
codes.condition: A TOF .iparm bank has no PRCF set 1, or states a set other than 1: the profile coefficients are left at zero or the set is not read (set 1 is GSAS's default whatever its function). Two sites.

codes.name: GSAS_IPARM_PROFILE_READ
codes.condition: A TOF .iparm's PRCF set 1 is read in the order the Technical Manual lists the coefficients; the order is an assumption and the record says so.
codes.note: the ordering is an assumption under the act

codes.name: GSAS_PRM_FIELD_DROPPED
codes.condition: A .prm record or field has no slot in the Instrument and is not carried.

codes.name: GSAS_PRM_FIELD_NOT_WRITTEN
codes.condition: The Instrument holds parts the .prm cannot state; they are not written.

codes.name: GSAS_PRM_GEOMETRY_ASSUMED
codes.condition: A .prm states no geometry, so none is read from it.

codes.name: GSAS_PRM_PROFILE_SET_DEFAULTED
codes.condition: Bank 1 offers several profile sets and none was named: one is read.

codes.name: GSAS_PRM_VALUE_NARROWED
codes.condition: A written value needs more characters than a .prm's fixed columns hold and is written to what fits.

codes.name: LANDE_G_ASSUMED
codes.condition: A site with an assumed ion that needs a g states none: the ion's Hund's-rule g_J is used.
codes.note: as MAGNETIC_ION_ASSUMED; both raise sites also in strategy/magnetic.py (2002 tiers them there)

codes.name: MAGNETIC_ION_ASSUMED
codes.condition: A magnetic site states no oxidation state and the neutral table lacks the element: its form factor is taken from an assumed ion (form_factor's assumed-ion table, 2002's B15).
codes.note: the table is the judgement under the act; ruled by 2002 (B15), tiered here after it

codes.name: PATTERN_DEAD_CHANNELS
codes.condition: A run of channels carries a small fraction of the local background with an esd that fell with it: the reader asserts they are dead. Nothing is dropped. The run and window lengths and the fraction are in background.diagnostics.dead_channels, outside io/.
codes.note: thresholds live in background/diagnostics.py (2004's walk)

codes.name: PATTERN_DUPLICATE_POINTS
codes.condition: Repeated x values carrying the same intensity are dropped.

codes.name: PATTERN_INTENSITY_SCALED
codes.condition: Intensity or σ is not the file's number: the unit is cps with no usable counting time, an unrecognised unit, or values not integral within INTEGRAL_TOL; no σ is supplied (Poisson fallback). Five sites in four readers (base, brml, uxd, xrdml).
site_guards: count_time is None or not np.all(np.asarray(count_time) > 0)
codes.note: gated by INTEGRAL_TOL (base.py site)

codes.name: PATTERN_MULTISCAN_DEFAULTED
codes.condition: A file holds several scans and none was named by scan=: scan 0 is read.

codes.name: PATTERN_ROWS_DROPPED
codes.condition: Numeric rows whose column count differs from the file's are not read as data.
site_guards: dropped and diagnostics is not None
codes.note: the file's arity is taken from the rows themselves

codes.name: PATTERN_SCAN_REVERSED
codes.condition: Points stored from high to low are reversed to ascending.

codes.name: PATTERN_SIGMA_CONSTANT
codes.condition: The σ column holds one value on every point. Raised after the read, no change made: the reader asserts that such a σ is not a measurement.
codes.note: asserts a judgement about the file

codes.name: PATTERN_X_AXIS_ASSUMED
codes.condition: A format whose axis label is absent or unrecognised: the x column is read as 2θ in degrees.
codes.note: the alternative is the refusal in the same function for an axis known not to be 2θ

codes.name: PATTERN_X_AXIS_IMPLAUSIBLE
codes.condition: The x axis starts at or below 0° with some points at or below 0°, in a format read as 2θ: the reader asserts the axis is not what it was read as. Nothing is changed.
codes.note: asserts a judgement; TWO_THETA_MAX_DEG is the upper-end refusal elsewhere in readers.py

codes.name: RAS_ATTENUATOR_PRESENT
codes.condition: A Rigaku .ras carries an attenuator factor other than 1: it is applied (or not) by the measured vendor convention and said so.
codes.note: the per-format convention is the judgement under the act

codes.name: READER_OPTION_IGNORED
codes.condition: A reader option the chosen format does not take is not applied.

codes.name: RECIPE_BACKGROUND_PEAK_DEGENERATE
codes.condition: A background peak starts at a FWHM that is broad against the fitted range, so it is a polynomial (asserts degeneracy; no change).
codes.note: asserts a judgement

codes.name: RECIPE_BACKGROUND_RESEEDED
codes.condition: A recipe's Chebyshev background arrives as a count and a flag, so its values start at zero.

codes.name: RECIPE_BOUND_HONOURED
codes.condition: A recipe declares min/max and the refinement applies them.
site_guards: allow_bounds and (lo is not None or hi is not None)

codes.name: RECIPE_CONVENTION_ASSUMED
codes.condition: SH/L is split evenly into axial_sl and axial_hl.

codes.name: RECIPE_DISPERSION_DECLINED
codes.condition: Anomalous scattering is declined and f = f0 is used, for the stated reason.

codes.name: RECIPE_ENGINE_DEFAULT_DECLINED
codes.condition: A null magnitude that GSAS-II fills with its own default is not filled: the sample broadening is zero here.

codes.name: RECIPE_FIELD_DROPPED
codes.condition: A recipe field has no counterpart or no effect here and is dropped (polarization on a neutron instrument; a constant Lorentzian term at zero; a sub-step background-peak width; refinement_cycles; refinement_algorithm). Five sites.

codes.name: RECIPE_FIT_RANGE_CHANNELS
codes.condition: The fit_range selects some channels on an inclusive mask at both ends.

codes.name: RECIPE_FLAG_DROPPED
codes.condition: A refine flag is not honoured (Z has no place; a background-peak gamma has no counterpart; LG_eta at its off state holds a coefficient). Three sites.

codes.name: RECIPE_FLAG_TRANSLATED
codes.condition: A (magnitude, eta) pair with the eta flag is translated to two free coefficients.

codes.name: RECIPE_NOTHING_REFINED
codes.condition: No parameter is flagged for refinement; the plan has one stage that frees nothing (asserts the recipe frees nothing).

codes.name: RECIPE_PLAN_STAGED
codes.condition: The flagged parameters are freed over several stages in the McCusker (1999) turn-on order.
codes.note: McCusker's order is a citation behind the act

codes.name: RECIPE_SCALE_RESEEDED
codes.condition: The recipe's phase scales are re-seeded to match the summed calculated intensity to the data.

codes.name: RECIPE_SCHEMA_UNTESTED
codes.condition: The recipe's schema_version is not one this reader was checked against; asserts the reading is unverified. Nothing is changed.
codes.note: asserts a judgement about verification

codes.name: RECIPE_ZERO_WEIGHT_EXCLUDED
codes.condition: Channels carrying weight 0 become excluded regions (the pdCIF dictionary: weight 0 means not used; #1006's row).
codes.note: the pdCIF weight rule is the row #1006 enters

codes.name: SITE_SNAPPED_TO_SPECIAL_POSITION
codes.condition: A site within SITE_TOL (symmetry.py) of a special position is expanded there; cif.py's second site also snaps a site to reach the multiplicity the file states, within CIF_STATED_MULTIPLICITY_SNAP_TOL.
codes.note: gated by SITE_TOL, CIF_STATED_MULTIPLICITY_SNAP_TOL

codes.name: SPACE_GROUP_SETTING_ASSUMED
codes.condition: A symbol the tables hold in more than one setting is resolved to one of them (the evidence is the composition each setting implies; WP-1118).
codes.note: act with a judgement inside: which setting is chosen

codes.name: TOPAS_BLOCK_SKIPPED
codes.condition: A block of the .inp is skipped and listed on model.skipped_blocks.

codes.name: TOPAS_CELL_COUPLING_DROPPED
codes.condition: A cell tie in a .inp is not carried and the space group does not tie it: the value is copied.

codes.name: TOPAS_FEATURES_NOT_IMPORTED
codes.condition: Features the file states (or calls without a definition) do not reach the Structure. Two sites.

codes.name: TOPAS_FEATURE_REFUSED
codes.condition: The file states something to_structure refuses to build without, or is time of flight (issue #193). Two sites.

codes.name: TOPAS_FIELD_NOT_WRITTEN
codes.condition: On writing, TOPAS computes each phase without a texture, magnetic-only width or extinction the Structure carries.

codes.name: TOPAS_FIRST_RUN_READ
codes.condition: An .inp has #if/#elseif on Run_Number and states more than one run: branches are read as the first run reads them.

codes.name: TOPAS_MAGNETIC_GROUP_READ
codes.condition: A magnetic phase's group is read from the file or derived; the text says which.
site_guards: ph.name in group_from_file or derived is not None

codes.name: TOPAS_MAGNETIC_PART_MERGED
codes.condition: A TOPAS str read as the magnetic half of another is merged into it.

codes.name: TOPAS_MOMENT_CONVENTION
codes.condition: mlx, mly, mlz are read as fractional-basis components and stored as crystal-axis μ_B (mlx·|a|, …).
codes.note: a convention under the act (topas-mlx-is-fractional)

codes.name: TOPAS_MOMENT_G_HELD
codes.condition: A file that refines the Landé g (mg) is read as holding it.

codes.name: TOPAS_MOMENT_ION_UNCHARGED
codes.condition: A moment and an uncharged species: the species is read neutral.

codes.name: TOPAS_ORIGIN_TRANSLATED
codes.condition: A space-group symbol with an origin choice is read as the canonical one.

codes.name: TOPAS_PHASE_RESTATED_IN_P1
codes.condition: A phase with no mag_space_group in TOPAS is written in P1 with every copy tied.

codes.name: TOPAS_PHASE_TERM_READ
codes.condition: A prm p<n>_<term> is read as phase n's term.

codes.name: TOPAS_SPECIES_NORMALISED
codes.condition: A TOPAS species is respelled to the canonical species.

codes.name: TOPAS_SPECIES_WRITTEN_NEUTRAL
codes.condition: On writing, an ion the X-ray table lacks is written neutral (helper in scattering.py; two call sites).

codes.name: XRDML_ATTENUATOR_APPLIED
codes.condition: A PANalytical .xrdml carries a beam attenuation factor over some points: it is applied to the intensities.
codes.note: as RAS_ATTENUATOR_PRESENT

constants.decides: Draws per direction on a pair no certificate settles, when the caller names none (issue #565, decision 3): 12 between two irreps, where 8 % of the cubic pairs that 3 draws called equivalent were refuted by a draw within 12 (0.2 % at 12), and 3 inside one irrep. On the cubic ``P n -3 m:1`` at (0, 0, ½) the raise is what gives the four classes of the known answer rather than two. The 3 within an irrep is not measured the same way (the 8 % was counted on cross-irrep pairs only) and applies only to two *different* directions of one irrep, since the isometry certificate settles the rank-1 copies without a draw; 12 there would cost about 4 min more on the known answer (an estimate, not a measurement).

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.magnetic.isotropy.WITHIN_IRREP_DRAWS
constants.decides: Same group as CROSS_IRREP_DRAWS: Draws per direction on a pair no certificate settles, when the caller names none (issue #565, decision 3): 12 between two irreps, where 8 % of the cubic pairs that 3 draws called equivalent were refuted by a draw within 12 (0.2 % at 12), and 3 inside one irrep. On the cubic ``P n -3 m:1`` at (0, 0, ½) the raise is what gives the four classes of the known answer rather than two. The 3 within an irrep is not measured the same way (the 8 % was counted on cross-irrep pairs only) and applies only to two *different* directions of one irrep, since the isometry certificate settles the rank-1 copies without a draw; 12 there would cost about 4 min more on the known answer (an estimate, not a measurement).

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.magnetic.isotropy.ISOMETRY_RESIDUAL
constants.decides: The isometry certificate's accept bound (issue #565, part 3): the relative congruence residual max_s ‖QᵀG^B_sQ − G^A_s‖_max / max|G^A| and the orthogonality deviation ‖QᵀQ − I‖₂ of the quoted Q must both be at most this.

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.magnetic.isotropy.KERNEL_AMPLITUDE_RATIO
constants.decides: The full-stack guard of a Farkas certificate (issue #565, part 3, the promise made on #772).

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.magnetic.isotropy.FARKAS_FLOOR
constants.decides: The Farkas certificate's accept floor (issue #565, decision 2): a draw is certified only when the projected dual's optimum, λ_min/|λ|_max of Σ_s y_s G_s on the kernel-projected stack, is at least this.

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.magnetic.isotropy.FARKAS_QUOTE
constants.decides: The projected ratio the quoted certificate is moved inside to: the min-norm point sits on the PSD boundary to rounding (ratios −4e-16 to 2e-16 on the 49 draws), where an exact check can go either way between machines, so the certificate stored and checked is the nearest point toward the interior with at least this ratio (or half the interior anchor's, when that is lower). Two decades above ``FARKAS_FLOOR``; the per-certificate rounding bound (≤ 3.4e-14 measured) is more than three decades below it.

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.magnetic.isotropy.TRANSFER_FLOAT_STACK
constants.decides: A fit transfer (issue #565, item 6) whose margin μ = λ′/Γ on the target's projected live stack is below this is printed as "proved on the float Gram stack": the cone bound cos(ŷ, I) ≥ μ then sits within a few decades of the rounding allowance ρ, and the step from the float G_s to the exact ones (which no certificate here covers) can be a real share of it. A label, not a gate: the verdict rests on cos < μ − ρ either way. Measured on the 246 fit transfers of the six cubic sets (2026-09-30, both machines): μ 1.7e-9 to 3.5e-4, 14 below this, the largest ρ/μ 0.22.

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.magnetic.isotropy.DUAL_AFTER_RESTART

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.magnetic.isotropy.DEFAULT_CELL_SCALE

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.magnetic.isotropy._CLOSURE_LIMIT
constants.decides: Guard for :func:`_close_operations`: every crystallographic (little group x lattice index) case this module builds is far under this, so reaching it is a bug in the seed list, not a tolerance to raise.

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.magnetic.isotropy._SPAN_GAP

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.magnetic.moments.MOMENT_DIRECTION_SUPPORT

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.magnetic.moments.DOF_NAMES

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.magnetic.moments.DOF_UNITS

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.magnetic.moments.SEED_TILT

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.magnetic.operators.N_MAGNETIC_SPACE_GROUPS

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.magnetic.operators.IDENTITY

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.magnetic.operators.TIME_REVERSAL

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.magnetic.operators._MAX_CODE

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.magnetic.p1._WRAP_TOL
constants.decides: A coordinate this close to the next lattice point after wrapping is that point: ``-1e-17 % 1.0`` is ``1.0`` in floating point, which is outside [0, 1).

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.magnetic.scattering.P_MAGNETIC_FM
constants.decides: p = γ·r₀/2, the magnetic scattering length of one Bohr magneton, in **fm** — the unit ``crystallography.neutron``'s Sears table gives b in, which is what lets |F_m|² and |F_N|² share one scale (issue #257 A6 iv).

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.magnetic.scattering.METRIC_TOL
constants.decides: |RᵀGR − G| / max|G| above which a magnetic operation is not a symmetry of the cell.

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.magnetic.scattering.INVARIANCE_POS_TOL
constants.decides: fractional-coordinate tolerance for matching an image to an atom of the compiled structure.

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.magnetic.scattering.INVARIANCE_MOMENT_TOL
constants.decides: moment tolerance for the same match, μ_B, relative to max(1, |m|)

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.neutron.RESONANCE_ENERGY_EV
constants.decides: Energy (eV) of the **lowest positive-energy resonance** of each nuclide that makes it a resonant absorber, from the resolved-resonance parameters of ENDF/B-VIII.0 (Brown et al. 2018, *Nucl. Data Sheets* **148**, 1); the lowest one sets how far a thermal wavelength sits from the resonance; bound (negative-energy) levels are left out.

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.neutron.NEUTRON_LAMBDA_EV_ANGSTROM
constants.decides: λ(Å) = NEUTRON_LAMBDA_EV_ANGSTROM / sqrt(E / eV): h / sqrt(2 m_n E) with CODATA 2018 h, m_n and e.

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.neutron.SIGMA_ABS_REFERENCE_WAVELENGTH

constants.decides: Rank and residual tolerance on the projected subspaces.

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.representation.distortion._POSITION_TOL

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.representation.distortion._PROBE_AMPLITUDE
constants.decides: The order-of-magnitude scale (Å) of the generic displacement used to read a component's isotropy subgroup with spglib, and spglib's tolerance on it.

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.representation.distortion._PROBE_SYMPREC
constants.decides: spglib's tolerance on the generic displacement probe, with _PROBE_AMPLITUDE.

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.representation.irreps.K_MAX_DENOMINATOR
constants.decides: Largest denominator :func:`as_kvector` will read out of a float.

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.representation.irreps.K_FLOAT_TOL

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.representation.irreps.IRREP_ATOL
constants.decides: Tolerance on the irrep matrices, which come from an eigendecomposition of a matrix of order |P_k| ≤ 48 built from unit-modulus entries.

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.representation.irreps._SEEDS
constants.decides: Seeds tried, in order, for the random Hermitian matrix whose commutant average splits the twisted regular representation.

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.representation.irreps._ZERO
constants.decides: Exact 0 for the same tables.

constants.decides: Integer identity matrix for the irreps code.

constants.decides: Exact 2/3, same use.

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.representation.modes.MODE_ATOL
constants.decides: Tolerance on the projected quantities.

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.representation.modes.POSITION_ATOL

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.representation.order_parameter.ISOTROPY_ATOL

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.representation.order_parameter._SIMPLE

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.riding.RIDING_LENGTHS
constants.decides: X–H lengths (Å) by bond class and radiation, the source of each column given in the module docstring. ``None`` would mean no tabulated value and is refused; no entry is ``None`` today.

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.riding.RIDING_MIN_SEPARATION
constants.decides: Å: an H closer than this to its parent gives no parent→H direction.

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.rotation.SERIES_THRESHOLD
constants.decides: |ω| (rad) below which A, B and C are evaluated by their series (module docstring, "The small-angle branch").

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.rotation.UNIT_TOLERANCE
constants.decides: How far ‖q‖ may sit from 1, or RᵀR from I, before an input is refused rather than read as a rotation.

constants.decides: Maclaurin coefficients through θ¹⁰ (in powers of θ²), lowest first: A = Σ (−1)ᵏ θ²ᵏ/(2k+1)!,  B = Σ (−1)ᵏ θ²ᵏ/(2k+2)!,  C = Σ (−1)ᵏ θ²ᵏ/(2k+3)!.

constants.decides: Same group as _A_SERIES: Maclaurin coefficients through θ¹⁰ (in powers of θ²), lowest first: A = Σ (−1)ᵏ θ²ᵏ/(2k+1)!,  B = Σ (−1)ᵏ θ²ᵏ/(2k+2)!,  C = Σ (−1)ᵏ θ²ᵏ/(2k+3)!.

constants.name: rietx.crystallography.species._HYDROGEN_NUCLIDE_MASS_NUMBER
